description: The contract between the two local span sinks: the TypeScript gateway (src/infra/observability/console-exporter.ts) and the native Rust arm (crates/memphis-operator/src/telemetry.rs). Both write the same status file shape and produce the same retry schedule, so the SLO report can tell a broken sink apart from an idle runtime. Checked by tests/unit/observability-sink-contract.test.ts and crates/memphis-operator/tests/sink_contract.rs.

statusFile.directory: the data directory, NOT telemetry/ — a span write and a status write fail for different reasons, and the status file has to survive the case where telemetry/ is the thing that is unwritable

retry.description: The delay before the next write attempt after N consecutive failures. 1-based: the delay after the first failure is the base delay. The delay doubles per further failure and is capped at maxMs.
